title: Guest Support VA
description:
Position Overview

The Guest support VA will primarily provide exceptional support to guests staying at the client’s short-term rental properties. As the first point of contact for the guests, you will handle inquiries, resolve issues, and ensure smooth check-in and check-out processes, all while maintaining high standards of customer service. This role requires a reliable, proactive individual who can manage tasks independently and communicate effectively with guests, vendors, and the management team.



Key Responsibilities:



Guest Communication & Support

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries via phone,
, chat, and messaging platforms.

- Assist guests with reservations, booking modifications, check-in/check-out instructions, and property information.

- Resolve guest concerns efficiently while maintaining excellent customer service.

- Follow up with guests and assist in managing guest reviews and feedback.



Booking Management

- Manage reservations across multiple booking platforms, including Airbnb, 
, VRBO, and Hostaway.

- Update booking calendars and reservation details.

- Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance teams to ensure properties are guest-ready.

- Block dates, adjust reservations, and communicate schedule changes when necessary.



Property Management Support

- Maintain and update property listings with accurate descriptions, amenities, pricing, and photos.

- Conduct regular listing audits to ensure information is current and optimized.

- Coordinate routine and emergency maintenance with vendors and internal teams.



Content & Listing Optimization

- Create and update engaging content for our company
 page

- Improve listing descriptions, titles, amenities, and house manuals to increase bookings and enhance the guest experience.



Administrative Support

- Perform various administrative tasks as assigned.

- Assist in creating and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Maintain organized records and documentation.

- Support operations and special projects when needed.



Qualifications

- Experience in short-term rental (STR), Airbnb, vacation rental, or property management is required.

- Strong customer service background with a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Extremely detail-oriented and organized. 

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.

- Able to prioritize urgent tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.

- Proactive, resourceful, and takes initiative.

- Quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes. 

- Available to work during U.S. business hours, including overnight/night shifts. 



Compensation: $4 per hour starting rate and increase after probation period to $5/hr. 



How to Apply



To be considered for this position, please complete the Google Form below: 



Required Application Materials



We are looking for applicants who take the time to submit a thoughtful application. Please do not submit a generic or copy-and-paste application.We want to get to know you and understand why you're a good fit for this role.



Please include all of the following:

1. Updated Resume

2. Loom Video (3–5 minutes)

 - Introduce yourself.

 - Share your relevant work experience. 

 - Tell us why you're interested in joining our team.

 - Answer this question: "Tell us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a satisfied one. What did you do, and what was the outcome?"

3. Completed Google Application Form



Applications that are incomplete or missing any of the required materials will not be reviewed.

title: Social Media Posting Assistant (Remote Phones, TikTok & Instagram)
description:
We're a small team managing social media accounts for content creators. Our videos are already edited – your job is to get them online, correctly and at the right time.



What you'll do

- Post finished videos on TikTok, Instagram and similar platforms via remote phones (you control real phones from your PC)

- Add the right caption, sound and settings for each account

- Follow a daily posting plan and report back what you posted

- Keep the accounts healthy: follow platform rules, notice when something looks off



How the hours work

You don't sit at the PC all day. We post at the peak times of our audiences (Europe and US), so your work comes in short blocks at fixed times of the day – including some evening/night hours in the Philippines. Part-time, around 3–4 hours per day.



What you need

- A PC or laptop and stable internet (a backup for power/internet is a plus)

- You know TikTok and Instagram well (as a user is fine, as a VA even better)

- Very careful and reliable – the right video on the right account, every time

- Good English



What we offer

- Fixed monthly salary of 200–300 USD, depending on the posting volume

- Long-term, remote

- Clear guides and a simple daily workflow



How it works: apply here, then we'll send you a link to our application page (one page, ~10 min, incl. a short intro video).

To show you read this: you'll need the word PEAK on the application page.

5. SYSTEMS & IMPROVEMENT

- Create and maintain SOPs and make sure the team follows them.

- Streamline or automate repetitive tasks; work with CRM/tech support to fix system issues.

- Increase the number of qualified opportunities reaching acquisitions.





IDEAL CANDIDATE



- 3+ years in real estate wholesaling or investment operations with US sellers.

- Experience managing remote outreach, acquisitions, or sales teams.

- Experience with CRMs, pipeline management, SOPs, dashboards, and accountability systems.

- Strong with KPIs and data-driven decisions.

- Familiar with NEPQ or similar consultative sales approaches and seller psychology.

- Excellent written and spoken English; understands US culture.

- Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working US EST hours.





THIS IS NOT A TASK-DOER ROLE



You are the people leader, performance driver, and daily operator of our business. This isn't a background seat where the team runs itself and you send a weekly report. We need someone who takes ownership, spots problems early, holds themselves and others accountable, and builds a transparent, organized team culture. title: Outbound B2B Sales Rep – Full-Cycle (US Healthcare)
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:



We're hiring a full-cycle Outbound B2B Sales Rep/Enterprise Sales Representative to own a high-volume outbound pipeline from first touch to close — and then keep owning that book of accounts after the deal closes. This isn't a hand-off model: you prospect it, qualify it, close it, and grow it. You'll work a defined territory of B2B accounts (non-acute healthcare strongly preferred), carry an individual quota, and partner closely with Marketing, Operations, and Compliance to keep every account you land running smoothly.



Key Responsibilities:



• Own a full-cycle, high-volume outbound sales pipeline — prospecting and generating net-new demand within a defined book of B2B accounts (non-acute healthcare preferred; multi-location or multinational commercial accounts also considered)

• Execute structured outbound campaigns — cold calling,
/sequence outreach, LinkedIn and social prospecting, and referral or win-back calling — to build and continuously refill a self-sourced pipeline

• Run full-cycle deal ownership: qualify opportunities, present tailored proposals, negotiate terms, and close net-new business without handing off to a separate closer

• Own the end-to-end relationship for your book of accounts post-close — resolving service needs and identifying upsell, cross-sell, and renewal opportunities

• Carry and consistently deliver against an individual sales quota, with disciplined tracking of prospecting activity, pipeline creation, and quota attainment

• Run a structured, discovery-driven sales process — identifying decision-makers and gatekeepers, uncovering pain points, positioning MedPro/MP1's value proposition, and driving every conversation to a clear next step or close

• Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene (Salesforce or equivalent), accurate pipeline staging, and forecast reporting

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations, and Compliance for smooth account setup/onboarding, and participate in ongoing sales enablement — coaching, call reviews, and objection-handling refinement



Required Qualifications



• 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with a background in proactive prospecting and outbound sales, and a demonstrated, verifiable track record of consistent quota attainment across an end-to-end, close-your-own-book sales cycle

• High-volume, B2B non-acute healthcare sales experience strongly preferred; candidates without direct healthcare background must show comparable experience selling into other regulated, multi-location, or multinational commercial accounts, plus demonstrated experience owning a book of accounts end-to-end (not a pure hunter-only or farmer-only profile)

• CRM proficiency (Salesforce or equivalent), comfort with sales engagement/sequencing tools (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft), and metrics-driven pipeline management

• Bachelor's degree preferred; relevant experience considered in lieu of a degree



Preferred Qualifications:



• Experience selling into healthcare, dental, or other regulated/compliance-driven verticals, or a clearly transferable regulated-services sales background

• Experience selling against an entrenched incumbent competitor (competitive displacement sales)

• Prior experience on an offshore/PH-based team supporting a US sales organization



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM CST (aligned to US Enterprise Sales team hours)

Work Arrangement: Full-time, remote (Philippines)

Compensation: Starting rate at $800/month + uncapped commissions



Application Process:



To submit your application, please
 the following to 

• Your most updated resume

• Use the following subject line: [Your Full Name] – Outbound B2B Sales Rep – Remote



Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview: 

We are seeking a highly proactive and experienced Project Manager to keep the execution engine of the organization running. This role sits inside the President and CEO's meeting cadence, owns follow-through on every action item across the business, and drives cross-functional execution between leadership and the teams delivering the work.



This is a high-impact, fully remote role requiring someone who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively in an asynchronous environment. The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of experience in a senior operating, project management, chief of staff, or executive business-partner role, with full overlap with U.S. business hours — standard schedule is 8:00 AM–4:30 PM CST, Monday–Friday, though this may shift based on executive needs.



Success in this role looks like nothing falling through the cracks: every decision reaches a documented conclusion, every open loop is tracked to closure, and every meeting opens with a clear readout of what's done, what's pending, and what's overdue.



Key Responsibilities:



• Attend business and functional leadership meetings led by the President and CEO, serving as an embedded partner in the day-to-day operating cadence

• Review meeting transcripts and recordings for accuracy and clarity on follow-up items and open action items

• Own action items through to completion across all responsible stakeholders, driving accountability across the organization

• Drive follow-up and decisions to specific, documented conclusions rather than leaving items open-ended

• Codify outcomes and prepare readouts for subsequent meetings, ensuring continuity across the leadership meeting cadence

• Open each meeting with a status readout covering closed items, open loops, and anything past due

• Coordinate cross-functionally between executive leadership and the development/operations teams, and support the transition of legacy operating practices into AI-supported workflows

• Partner with product managers and cross-functional leaders across the business to align priorities and drive follow-through, extending beyond the immediate development team

• Balance strategic and tactical execution — operate at the level of executive intent while also driving the granular, day-to-day follow-through needed to close items out

• Exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential or sensitive business information encountered through leadership meetings and communications

• Represent executive leadership's priorities and intent when following up with stakeholders, ensuring alignment without requiring constant direct input

• Additional tasks as assigned



Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years in a senior operating, project management, chief of staff, or executive business-partner role

• Experience directly supporting C-suite or founder-level executives in a fast-moving business environment; healthcare/compliance exposure a plus, not required

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, project/task tracking software, and comfort working with AI-based meeting and transcription tools

• Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience accepted

• Demonstrated ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical, detail-level execution

• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience interacting directly with senior leadership

• High discretion and sound judgment handling confidential information

• Comfortable operating with autonomy and ambiguity, driving outcomes without close supervision

• Must maintain full overlap with US business hours (8:00 AM–4:30 PM CST standard, subject to change)



Nice-To-Have:

• Prior experience in a senior project management or chief-of-staff-style capacity at a growing or founder-led company, working closely with executive leadership

• Familiarity with AI-driven operating tools and workflow automation



Compensation & Benefits:

• $14.00/hr rate, based on experience — no commission structure

• Permanent work-from-home

• 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. business hours (CST, graveyard shift).

• Fixed weekends off (Saturday & Sunday)

• Work Anniversary Bonus

• No work with pay on US Holidays

• Paid Leaves after 6 months of employment



Basic Technical Requirements:

• Your own laptop/desktop PC with the following minimum specs: i5 5th gen and above/AMD equivalent; 8GB RAM; Mozilla or Chrome installed; Windows 10 upwards.

• A consistent and stable internet connection of at least 20Mbps

• With back-up computer, internet connection and power supply

• Noise-canceling headset/headphones

• A quiet and dedicated workspace at home

title: Versatile Video Editor (YouTube, Reels, UGC and Faceless Content)
description:
Hi! We're Only You Marketing, a US-based marketing and social media agency, and we're growing. We're looking for a talented, versatile video editor to join our team and support both our agency clients and our sister brand, Floé.



Floé is a video content subscription service that delivers weekly short-form videos to small businesses. The Floé look is sophisticated and premium: soft, elegant, and vintage-inspired.



This is not a one-style role. One day you might cut a long-form YouTube video, the next you're editing Reels for a real estate client, and then putting together a UGC-style ad. If you love variety and can switch styles easily, you'll fit right in.



What you'll be editing:



 • YouTube videos (long-form) for our clients

 • Instagram Reels, TikToks and other short-form content

 • UGC (user-generated content) videos for brands

 • Faceless content using text overlays, B-roll, screen recordings, motion graphics and AI voiceover

 • Weekly short-form videos for Floé subscription clients



Our clients include: real estate, health and wellness, fitness, beauty, e-commerce and professional services.



What we're looking for:



 • Proven experience editing both long-form and short-form video

 • A strong eye for pacing, hooks and trends that keep viewers watching

 • Ability to match different brand styles and aesthetics

 • Comfortable editing faceless content (no on-camera talent)

 • Reliable, organized and able to meet weekly deadlines

 • Open to feedback and revisions

 • Good English communication



Tools we use:



 • Adobe Premiere Pro (required)

 • ElevenLabs (AI voiceover)



To apply:

Send your portfolio with examples of YouTube, Reels and UGC work. Start your application with the word "FLOÉ" so we know you read the full post. 😊

About the role

We are looking for a skilled, detail-driven social media manager to take our raw content and turn it into polished, high-quality posts across our channels. We will supply the photos and video footage. Your job is to edit it, write the copy, schedule everything and put it forward for approval before it goes live.

Alongside the day-to-day, we want you to build and own the system behind it: where content lives, how raw files are uploaded and labelled, and how a post moves from footage to published. The aim is a process that is simple, consistent and easy for anyone on the team to follow.

Key responsibilities

Editing

• Edit raw video into finished reels, stories and short-form content suited to each platform

• Edit and retouch photography to a consistent, high standard

• Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, music and transitions in line with our brand

• Produce correctly sized versions for each platform (e.g. 9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

• Keep a consistent visual style across every post

Copywriting

• Write captions, hooks and calls to action that match our tone of voice

• Research and apply relevant hashtags, tags and locations

• Adapt copy for each platform rather than posting the same text everywhere

• Proofread everything before it goes for approval

Scheduling and publishing

• Build and maintain a rolling content calendar, planned at least two weeks ahead

• Schedule all approved content using a scheduling tool

• Post at the times that perform best for our audience

• Make sure nothing goes live without sign-off

Approval workflow

• Submit each batch of content (edited asset, copy and planned date) for review by the founder

• Action feedback and amendments quickly and resubmit

• Keep a clear record of what is drafted, awaiting approval, approved and scheduled

Content organisation and process

• Design and set up a shared folder structure for all content (e.g. by brand, project, date and status: raw, in edit, approved, published)

• Create a simple process for how the team uploads raw videos and images, including file naming conventions and where each type of file goes

• Write a short guide so anyone supplying content knows exactly what to do

• Archive published content so it is easy to find and reuse later

• Review and improve the process as we grow

What we will provide

• Raw photography and video footage

• Brand guidelines, tone of voice and key messages

• Access to our social accounts and shared storage

• Timely feedback and approval

First 30 days

Within your first month we would expect you to:

1. Audit our current channels and content

2. Set up the folder structure, naming conventions and upload process, with a one-page guide for the team

3. Build the content calendar and approval workflow

4. Have the first two weeks of content edited, written and approved

Skills and experience

Essential

• Proven experience managing social media for a business or brand (please share a portfolio)

• Strong video editing skills (e.g. Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut or similar)

• Strong photo editing skills (e.g. Lightroom, Photoshop)

• Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

• Experience with scheduling tools (e.g. Meta Business Suite, Later, Buffer, Metricool)

Desirable

• Experience in property, lifestyle, outdoor or premium brands

Platforms

Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube

title: Senior Content Producer — Short/Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels
description:
# Senior Content Producer — Short/Long-Form Video & Graphic Carousels

**Company:** Maverick Creative Group 

**Type:** Full-time, remote 

**Hours:** US Pacific Time, with required attendance at the daily review call, 9:00–11:00 AM PT 

**Reports to:** Operations Lead (daily)



---



## Overview

Maverick Creative Group is a California digital marketing agency. We build complete growth systems for American small businesses — websites, funnels, CRM automation, paid advertising, AI phone and chat assistants, and video and podcast production. Our clients are the people who keep American homes and neighborhoods running: contractors, plumbers, HVAC and roofing companies, real estate agents, and medical and dental clinics.



This is not a one-video-a-day editor role. It is a systematic media production role: design systems, asset batching, daily review syncs, and a clear standard for what "done" means. If you build production systems, hit high-volume benchmarks, and implement feedback fast, this role is for you.



---



## Role Breakdown

| Area | What you own |

| :--- | :--- |

| **Short-form video** | 20–25 finished Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts per day |

| **Graphic carousels** | Instagram, LinkedIn, and
 carousels of 5–10 slides |

| **Long-form video** | 10–30 minute podcasts, YouTube breakdowns, and software walkthroughs |

| **Synthetic media** | AI presenter clips and synthetic voiceovers when raw human footage isn't available |

| **Screen captures** | Vertical 9:16 desktop software demos |

| **Quality control** | Safe zones, spelling, pricing, and compliance |



---



## Responsibilities

1. **High-volume short-form reels:** Produce 20–25 finished short-form videos a day for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, with a target of 100+ approved assets per week at full ramp. You work from brand design systems and hook libraries, repurposing one source recording into multiple high-converting variants.

2. **Graphic carousels:** Design high-converting 5–10 slide carousels for Instagram, LinkedIn, and
 in 
, Photoshop, or Illustrator. Slide one is the hook, visual hierarchy is clean, and every slide stays on brand.

3. **Long-form editing:** Edit 10–30 minute podcasts, YouTube breakdowns, and software walkthroughs, including multi-cam sync, audio cleanup, and retention pacing. Carve each long recording into bite-sized Shorts and clips.

4. **Synthetic media:** Generate synthetic presenter clips in HeyGen/Descript when raw human clips aren't available. A generated presenter is always labelled as AI-generated where the platform requires it, and never appears as a fake customer or reviewer.

5. **Desktop screen captures:** Record and format vertical 9:16 demos of agency CRM workflows, with zoom-ins, voiceovers, and mobile-readable text.

6. **Lead-gen CTAs:** Design high-contrast end cards and keyword callouts (e.g., "Comment LAUNCH below") that feed our comment-automation funnels.

7. **Safe zones and QA:** Keep text and logos clear of platform UI buttons. Run a QA checklist on every piece before it goes to review: zero typos, prices exactly as approved sheets print them, and no unapproved claims.

8. **Reporting:** Name files systematically (e.g., `MCG_D07_video_ProductA_v1`), log every piece in the shared drive the same day, and attach supplied tracking links.



---



## Requirements

**Must have:**

- A strong portfolio containing short-form reels, graphic carousels, and long-form video edits (All 3 required).

- Proven daily output at volume, shown with real portfolio examples.

- Expert skill in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut.

- Skill in Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva.

- Hands-on experience with HeyGen/Descript, and desktop screen recording tools.

- Working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube formats.

- Availability on US Pacific hours, including the 9:00–11:00 AM PT review call every day.

- A reliable machine, high-speed connection, quiet workspace, and 2FA on work accounts.



**Content standards you'll follow:**

- 9:16 at 1080×1920 for video, and 4:5 at 1080×1350 for carousels, unless specified otherwise.

- Brand colors: Navy `#0A1420`, Gold `#C9A24B`, Ivory `#ECEBE3`. Typography: Playfair Display (Headlines), Inter (Body).

- Licensed music only.

- Zero unapproved earnings, performance, or ranking claims.

- Every agency AI employee/avatar is clearly identified as AI.



---



## Hiring Process

1. **Portfolio & Resume Review:** Applications must include short-form reels, graphic carousels, and long-form video edits.

2. **Initial Interview:** 30 minutes covering output proof, template workflows, compliance judgment, and availability for daily PT review calls.

3. **Paid 5-Day Trial Batch:** You work from a source pack, deliver a defined batch of finished assets, and implement revisions from morning review calls. We evaluate:

   - **Speed:** Pieces delivered vs. target timeframe.

   - **Accuracy:** Zero compliance, pricing, or typo misses.

   - **Revisions:** Speed and completeness of feedback implementation.

   - **First-pass approval:** Benchmark of 90%+ assets approved without rework.



---



## Application Instructions

Apply with the subject line "Senior Content Producer — [Your Name]" and include:

1. Your resume.

2. Direct links to **at least three** short-form reels, **two** carousels, and **one** long-form video edit.

3. Answers to these questions:

   - How many finished short-form pieces do you produce on a typical day, and how long does each take you?

   - Can you attend a daily 9:00–11:00 AM US Pacific review call? What local time is that for you?

4. Your earliest start date.

- Proactively contact customers regarding shipping delays, delivery issues, replacements and outstanding cases.

- Work closely with our Supply Chain Manager.

- Review supplier updates and order statuses daily.

- Review negative feedback and identify customer cases requiring attention.

- Proactively follow up with dissatisfied customers to resolve complaints.

- Encourage satisfied customers to share honest reviews where appropriate.

- Strong problem-solving and negotiation skills.

- Confident, professional and empathetic communication style.

- Experience with Shopify is highly preferred.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Remote position

Coalition Technologies is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Remote Accountant / Accounting Specialist to support our accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes. This role is ideal for someone with strong QuickBooks Online experience, advanced Excel skills, and the ability to manage accurate financial records in a fast-paced remote work environment.



We are looking for talented, diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong assessment results may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.



Why Join Coalition Technologies?



Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:



100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

Subsidized gym memberships

Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

Accounting Responsibilities



As an Accountant / Accounting Specialist, your duties will include:



Recording financial transactions in QuickBooks Online

Reconciling general ledger accounts, journal entries, and bank statements

Preparing and analyzing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements

Reviewing monthly financials and performance metrics to help improve cash flow and business efficiency

Comparing annual budgets and cash flow forecasts against actual results

Preparing and submitting annual and quarterly taxes to city, county, state, and federal authorities

Supporting additional accounting, finance, bookkeeping, and administrative duties as assigned

Required and Preferred Qualifications



The ideal candidate will have:



Competency in preparing local, state, and federal taxes for a small company

A minimum of 3 years of professional accounting experience preferred

Experience with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office

Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, and Google Docs preferred

Strong quantitative, analytical, and writing skills

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work with diverse teams and departments

A flexible, team-oriented mindset and the ability to work well under pressure

Experience working with a startup preferred

Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

Ability to complete other duties as assigned

Candidates may be tested on QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office, and other relevant accounting skills.

Remote Work Environment



Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We welcome qualified applicants from around the world.



Compensation



For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $17 to $50 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

title: Operations & Project Execution (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers.



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before.

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up:

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing.

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners.



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply.



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership.



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level.

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no random meetings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to.

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit.



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove from messy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.”

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4: Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.”

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Scheduler - Dental
description:
Company: Smile Group

Position: Dental Scheduler

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time EST time

Compensation: $2.50 USD/hour base pay + $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment scheduled



About the Position



Smile Group is looking for a motivated, confident, and knowledgeable Dental Scheduler to join our team remotely.



This is not a traditional call-center position.



Our schedulers are an important part of each dental office and are often the first point of contact for our patients. You will work directly with our dental teams to answer incoming calls, make outbound calls, schedule patients, answer common dental questions, and help keep our doctors’ and hygienists’ schedules full.



We are specifically looking for candidates who already have dental knowledge and dental scheduling experience or a strong understanding of dental procedures, terminology, and appointment types.



Fluent English and Spanish is required for this position.



Compensation



The compensation structure is designed to reward performance:



Base Pay: $2.50 USD per hour

Performance Bonus: $2.00 USD per qualifying appointment you successfully schedule



This means your earning potential is directly connected to your performance. The more successful appointments you create, the more you can earn.



For performance bonuses, appointments must meet the company’s qualification requirements, including patient attendance/completion when applicable.



We want motivated schedulers who are excited by the opportunity to earn additional compensation by helping keep our offices productive and our schedules full.



Main Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to answer incoming patient calls and make outbound calls to schedule patients.



You will work with multiple scheduling opportunities, including:



New patient calls and inquiries

New patient scheduling

Patient reactivation

Patients who missed previous appointments

Patients who canceled and need to reschedule

Patients due for hygiene/cleaning appointments

Patients who completed SRP and are due for periodontal maintenance

Patients with treatment plans who have not scheduled

Patients who have already paid for treatment but do not have an appointment

Following up with patients to help fill openings in the schedule

Confirming and maintaining productive schedules

Helping the offices work toward zero missed calls

Dental Knowledge Is Required



This position requires more than excellent phone skills.

You must be able to speak confidently with patients about common dental procedures and appointments.



For example, you should understand or be able to confidently explain:



The difference between a regular prophylaxis/prophy and Scaling and Root Planing (SRP)

Why a patient may need SRP instead of a regular cleaning

What a patient can expect during common dental appointments

How many appointments may be required for a crown

Basic steps involved in crown treatment

Basic implant treatment processes

Pre-operative and post-operative appointments related to implants

Hygiene and periodontal maintenance appointments

Common dental terminology

How to schedule different dental procedures appropriately



We do not expect the scheduler to diagnose patients or answer questions that require a dentist or clinical provider. However, you should be able to confidently handle common patient questions without unnecessarily transferring every call.



Our goal is minimum unnecessary escalations and minimum unnecessary transfers to office managers.



Language Requirements

Fluent English and Spanish is required.

Because you will be speaking with patients throughout the day, you must be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.



You should be comfortable:



Answering patient calls in English

Explaining dental appointments and procedures clearly

Handling patient questions confidently

Communicating professionally through phone calls, text messages, and other patient communication channels

Understanding patients with different speaking styles and accents

Providing a high level of customer service in English



Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are encouraged to apply.



You Are Part of the Dental Office



We do not want our patients to feel like they are speaking with an outside call center.



You should never approach a patient conversation with:



“This is the call center. Let me transfer you to the office.”



You are part of the office team.



We want our patients to feel that they are speaking directly with a knowledgeable member of their dental office who understands their needs and can help them.



The scheduler is one of the most important roles in our organization because you:



Create the appointments that fill the doctors’ schedules

Help patients receive the treatment they need

Create the patient's first impression of our practice

Help prevent missed opportunities

Support the doctors, hygienists, managers, and clinical teams

Help maintain healthy and productive schedules



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:



Fluent spoken and written English — required

— a plus

Previous dental scheduling, dental receptionist, dental call center, or dental patient coordinator experience

Good knowledge of dental terminology

Understanding of common dental procedures

Experience scheduling dental appointments

Strong customer service skills

Confidence speaking with patients

Excellent telephone etiquette

Ability to explain information clearly and professionally

Strong follow-up skills

Ability to handle objections and encourage patients to schedule

High motivation and a performance-driven mindset

Ability to work independently

Reliability and consistency

Strong attention to detail

Ability to learn our systems and protocols quickly

A positive, team-oriented attitude

Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:



Answer calls consistently

Help us achieve as close to zero missed calls as possible

Create quality appointments

Convert patient inquiries into scheduled appointments

Follow up consistently with unscheduled patients

Keep schedules full

Communicate professionally with patients

Reduce unnecessary transfers

Understand dental appointment types

Work as a true member of the dental office team



This is a great opportunity for someone who already understands dentistry and enjoys speaking with patients, scheduling treatment, and working toward performance goals.



Shift: Mondays - Fridays 11:00PM - 6:30AM EST

Saturdays - 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST



Please include:

Your resume

Your previous dental experience

The dental software you have used

Your experience scheduling dental procedures

A short explanation of the difference between a prophy and an SRP

Your experience handling incoming and outbound patient calls

Your English and  Spanish proficiency level

Your available working hours

Your internet speed and computer specifications



Important: Strong dental knowledge and fluent English are important requirements for this position. Applicants without sufficient dental knowledge may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the Smile Group dental team, provide an excellent patient experience, and take advantage of a performance-based compensation structure with the opportunity to increase their earnings through successful scheduling.

title: NOW HIRING: Part-Time Outbound Appointment Setter | 20 hrs/week | Weekly Pay + Bonus Per Show
description:
NOW HIRING: Part-Time Outbound Appointment Setter | 20 hrs/week | Weekly Pay + Bonus Per Show



Do you like the phone but not the pressure of closing? This job is only about booking. You'll call US leads who asked for information about a resort vacation ownership (timeshare) presentation, confirm they qualify, and schedule them. The resort's sales team takes it from there.



WHAT YOU GET

- $4-8/hr base depending on experience, paid weekly via PayPal

- $15 bonus for every appointment that shows up (top setters earn well above base)

- Part-time, 20 hrs/week (5 hours a day, 4 days a week), long-term role

- Warm leads on a Five9 dialer, no cold list scraping



SCHEDULE

5-hour shift between 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM US Central

- Until Oct 31: within 10:00 PM to 9:00 AM Manila time

- Starting Nov 1: within 11:00 PM to 10:00 AM Manila time (US clock change)



YOU NEED

- 1+ year of outbound calling (timeshare, travel, real estate, or solar is a big plus)

- Clear, confident spoken English

- Wired internet, 25+ Mbps, plus a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS or power station)

- USB noise-cancelling headset and a quiet room

- Dialer experience (Five9 preferred)



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word OCEANVIEW

2. Attach a 60-second voice recording of you reading the script below

3. Tell us your calling experience, which dialers you've used, your internet speed, and which 5-hour block works best for you



SCRIPT TO RECORD

"Hi, is this Maria? Hi Maria, this is [your name] calling on behalf of Sunrise. You recently requested information, and we're inviting guests to a 90-minute presentation at Sunrise. Would you and your spouse be able to attend together? I have Thursday at 10 AM or Saturday at 2 PM. Which works better?"

title: Virtual Assistant – Business Development Associate – Real Estate—Immediate Start —Multiple Vacancies Available
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE - REFERRAL PARTNERSHIPS

Remote | Full-Time | Immediate Start



TYPE OF WORK

Full-time (UK business hours)



WAGE / SALARY

$300 per month fixed + $50-$100 for every referral that becomes a paying client (unlimited potential)



HOURS PER WEEK

40 hours, mostly UK business hours (approximately 9am-5pm UK, or 4pm-midnight Philippine time)



ABOUT US

We're a growing independent UK estate agency doing sales, lettings, property management and property maintenance. We're part of a global luxury real estate network and its exclusive lettings provider in the UK.



We have the brand and the back office. What we need now is a network of local partners who send us clients.



THE ROLE

Your job is to build and run our local referral partner network, reporting directly to the boss.



You will find tradespeople and local businesses, sign them up to a formal partnership where we pay them for sending us sales, lettings, management and maintenance clients, and then keep those partners active.



Tradespeople and local businesses spend their days in people's homes and talk to homeowners and landlords all the time. We want to be the first agent they think of.



WHO YOU WILL CONTACT

Builders, plumbers, electricians, roofers, decorators, locksmiths, cleaners, removal firms, gardeners and many other trades, plus businesses such as salons, solicitors, mortgage brokers and surveyors.



You will find them on Google Maps and other directories.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build lists of local businesses and trades in our target areas

- Contact them by phone, WhatsApp,
 and messaging, around 100 outreaches a day

- Explain the partnership and get them signed up

- Process the paperwork: send the partnership agreement, collect the signed copy and record everything in our CRM

- Keep a clear log of who has signed up, who is active and who has referred

- Follow up regularly with every partner: how business is going, whether they have met anyone who needs help, and how we can help them

- Send partners updates on the leads they have referred

- Identify the best partners and tell us who we should meet in person

- Come up with ideas to make the programme more attractive and more productive

- Send a weekly report: outreaches, sign-ups, active partners, referrals, results and what you would change



YOU MUST HAVE



- Clear, natural spoken English with a neutral accent, comfortable calling UK tradespeople

- Sales, business development, customer service or real estate experience

- Persistence in following up without being pushy

- Self-discipline to hit daily targets with little supervision

- Good written English and attention to detail with paperwork and records

- Reliable internet, a laptop or PC, and a quiet workspace

- Willingness to work UK business hours



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with a CRM

- Experience building referral or partner networks

- Property or construction industry experience

- Startup or small-team experience



PAY STRUCTURE

All payments are in USD, paid monthly by bank transfer.



FIXED BASE SALARY

$300 per month



HOW REFERRAL PAYMENTS WORK



- Referral payments apply to referrals from partners you recruit and manage, as recorded in our CRM, for 12 months from the date of each referral

- Referral payments are made once we have been paid

- Property sales: once the sale has completed

- Lettings: once the tenancy has started and the first rent has been received

- Maintenance: once the job has been completed and paid for

- No cap on referral earnings, so UNLIMITED EARNING POTENTIAL for high performers!





HOW TO APPLY

IMPORTANT: Please
 your CV and an introduction video to 



 subject line: REFERRAL BDA



*Applications without the video will not be considered.*



WHAT TO COVER IN YOUR VIDEO



Please answer the following questions:



1. What is your experience in sales, business development or real estate?

2. How would you persuade a busy plumber or builder to sign up to a referral partnership with an agency they have never heard of?

3. How would you keep hundreds of partners engaged so they actually send referrals?

4. How do you keep up consistent daily outreach, and how would you track what is working?

5. What other ideas do you have for finding people who can send us property owners?

6. How soon can you start, and can you work UK business hours?

7. Please confirm you understand the pay: a fixed base plus a fixed payment for each referral that becomes a paying client, paid after we have been paid.



We look forward to working with you!

title: Analytics Engineer – AI Agent Reporting & Dashboards
description:
About the role



ProNexis is hiring a contract analytics developer to turn our ConnexAI AI agent data into working operational dashboards. Our vendor has given us an empty, unconfigured dashboard and expects us to build the reporting ourselves.

You will define how conversations are classified, configure tracking inside the ConnexAI platform, and build dashboards our leadership and department heads use weekly. You will work directly with our operations lead, who owns the KPIs and business requirements.



This is a contract role, remote, starting as soon as possible.



Our environment



We run ConnexAI's Athena platform as a vendor-hosted cloud tenant. ConnexAI, formerly Connex One, is a UK-based enterprise contact center and conversational AI vendor



Required



• 3+ years building dashboards and reporting in data analytics or BI

• Strong SQL for querying, joining and shaping data

• Expert in at least one BI tool: Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase

• Hands-on work with REST APIs and JSON: authenticating, paging through results, handling errors

• Python, or an automation tool such as Zapier or Make, to schedule data pulls

• Able to turn vague business goals into clear metric definitions



Preferred



• Analytics for contact centers or AI chatbots: containment, escalation, handle time, abandonment, sentiment

• Experience with ConnexAI, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Talkdesk or a similar platform

• CRM data experience (HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho)

• Reporting for a data-heavy SaaS or platform business

• Data privacy awareness: handling customer conversation data and PII responsibly

title: AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR | FACEBOOK ADS (E-COMMERCE)
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We need someone who can help us produce high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about beautiful visuals. We want someone who understands how ads actually work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT YOU GET

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor (Reels, TikTok, Ads) for a Canadian Marketing Agency, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
Part-time now, growing into full-time. We start with about 10 short edits a week. As we sign more clients, it grows into as many as you can handle in a full day, and we want this to become your full-time job.



We’re Brightkort, a marketing agency in Canada. We run video ads for real estate agents, and we post our own videos too. We need an editor who can make short-form videos look sharp, fast and on brand.



What you’ll edit



Our personal brand videos: the founders talking to camera, cut for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

Client ads: real estate agents film themselves on their phones, and you turn that footage into
 and Instagram ads.



Most videos are 30 to 90 seconds.



How much work

Right now it’s about 10 short edits a week. As we sign more clients, it grows into as many as you can handle in a full day. We want this to become your full-time job.



Our style

We have a very specific style, and we’ll show you examples before you start. You’ll match it closely. That means a strong hook in the first 2 seconds, tight cuts with no dead air, clean bold captions, b-roll, punch-in zooms and good sound. Every video gets exported in 9:16, and some in 4:5.



What we need from you



At least 1 year editing short-form video for clients or brands (Reels, TikTok, Shorts or ads)

Your own pro editing software (any is fine, tell us which)

Strong English, because captions have to be spelled right every time

Turnaround of 24 to 48 hours per edit

You take feedback well and don’t make the same mistake twice

A few hours a day of overlap with Canada’s Central time

Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K phone footage



Nice to have



You’ve edited real estate videos or ads before

After Effects or simple motion graphics

You know what makes people stop scrolling



How we work

Files come through Google Drive and we talk in Slack. You’ll get a short style guide and example videos on day 1.



How to apply



Here’s the style we want. Watch these first:



Our own videos: 

Client ads: 



Start your message with “Brightkort Editor” so we know you read this. Then send:



2 or 3 links to short-form videos you edited (Reels, TikTok, YouTube or a Drive folder)

One line for each link saying what you did on it

Which software you use

How many hours a week you can work now, and if you’d go full-time later



Only send videos you edited yourself. If you send clips of famous creators or podcasts that you didn’t edit, we’ll skip you. Applications without video links get skipped too.



Everyone we shortlist does a short test edit (one video, about 30 seconds) using our real footage. We won’t use your test edit in any ad or post.



God bless!!

creative ? launch ? analysis ? optimization ? scale

creative generation

testing frameworks

Role Structure

Part-time contractor to start (20–25 hours per week)

Fully remote

Who This Is NOT For

Individuals excited to push the edge of AI-driven marketing



How to Apply



Please include:



Portfolio of ad creative and campaigns

Examples of performance improvements (CTR, CPA, ROAS)

Brief explanation of how you currently use AI in your workflow

Your hourly rate and availability

title: Logistics Virtual Assistant 30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr
description:
Logistics Virtual Assistant

30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr

Chameleon Science Pty Ltd · Australia



About the role

Chameleon Science sells research reagents to laboratories across Australia and New Zealand, sourced

from suppliers in the US, Europe and China. We handle 7–10 customer orders a week. Every order has

to be quoted, ordered from the supplier, cleared through Australian biosecurity, held at the right

temperature, delivered and invoiced.

You will run that process end to end, following our Order Logistics SOP. The role starts with logistics and

can grow into general admin.

We are looking for someone who follows a process carefully and then tells us how to make it better. If

you spot something that does not add up, we want you to stop and ask rather than push it through.

What you will own

Every order, from the customer's first request to delivery:

1. Quote the customer. Build quotes in Xero with correct pricing, freight (standard, blue ice or dry ice)

and lead time. Send them and log the deal in Pipedrive.

2. Take in orders. Check each customer PO against the quote, acknowledge it the same day, and

choose the shipping route.

3. Order from the supplier. Raise purchase orders in Xero in the supplier's currency. Track

confirmations, backorders and ship dates.

4. Prepare import paperwork. Send suppliers our import permit and manufacturer's declaration

template. Check the signed declaration matches the permit word for word.

5. Pre-clear and track. Send FedEx the clearance documents, track inbound shipments daily, and

answer customs queries the same day.

6. Arrange delivery. Brief our Sydney logistics partner, book couriers before the daily cutoff, and

manage cold-chain and dry-ice shipments.

7. Invoice. Send one Xero invoice per order at dispatch, with courier and tracking number.

8. Close out. Record delivery, keep Pipedrive and the shipment spreadsheet current, and enter

supplier bills in Xero.

Across every step:

• Answer overnight supplier questions first thing, before US and EU cutoffs.

• Check the orders@, accounts@ and info@ inboxes every day.

• Keep customers informed of ETAs and delays before they have to ask.

• Flag anything that does not match — prices, cartons, paperwork — before acting on it.

What stays with Kathryn during the trial

These decisions do not route to you in the first 30 days:

• Manufacturers declarations — you check them, Kathryn approves each one before the supplier is

told to ship.

• Courier and freight spend — ask before booking or approving.

• Permit wording for new product types — checked case by case.

• Overdue-invoice chasing — not part of the trial.

• FedEx import freight and duty invoices — Kathryn codes these in Xero.

Logins to FedEx, Toll, Team Global Express, Logistics 360, Xero, Pipedrive and the shipment

spreadsheet are set up on day one.

How hiring works

Step 1 — Application

Send a short note covering your logistics or order-processing experience and the systems you have

used, plus a 2-minute video introducing yourself.

Put DRY ICE as the first word of your subject line. Applications without it are not read — this role is

about reading instructions carefully, and this is the first test.

Step 2 — Paid test project

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour task built from a real order: check a set of order

documents, quote it, and tell us what to do next. Paid at the hourly rate above regardless of outcome.

Step 3 — 30-day paid trial

A paid, fixed-term engagement. It is a fair test both ways: you see whether the work suits you, and we

see whether you can run orders with less and less help.

The 30 days

Week Focus Done when

1 Learn the SOP, systems and partners.

Shadow live orders.



You can explain each step and know what

routes back to Kathryn.



2 Run quotes, PO intake and supplier POs, with

Kathryn checking.



Quotes and POs go out correct and same-

day.

3 Run import paperwork, tracking and dispatch,

with Kathryn checking.



Shipments pre-cleared and dispatched with

no missed cutoffs.



4 Run the full process end to end. Propose

improvements.



Most orders need no correction, and you

have proposed at least one SOP

improvement.



At the end we review together against four measures:

• Orders processed correctly from quote to invoice.

• Supplier and courier cutoffs met.

• Pipedrive, Xero and the shipment spreadsheet matching reality at the end of each day.

• Problems flagged early, with a clear question or a suggested fix.

If it goes well the role continues, with a long-term decision at around 90 days.

What you will need

Essential

• Experience in order processing, logistics, import/export or e-commerce admin.

• Strong attention to detail — you will match documents word for word and number for number.

• Clear written English for suppliers, customers, FedEx and couriers.

• Comfort working across several systems at once and keeping them in sync.

• Reliability with deadlines, and the judgement to ask before guessing.

• A process mindset: follow the SOP, then improve it.

Nice to have

• Xero, Pipedrive or another CRM.

• International freight, customs clearance or courier bookings.

• Cold-chain or dangerous goods (dry ice) shipping.

• Experience with Australian businesses or the life sciences.

• Using AI tools to work faster.

Terms

Contract Independent contractor, 30-day paid trial, extendable in further 30-day blocks.

Pay USD $7.50 per hour, paid fortnightly.

Hours 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Overlap Daily start by 6:00am Manila time (9:00am Sydney) to clear overnight supplier


. Courier bookings must be placed before 12:00pm Manila (3:00pm Sydney).



Location Remote. Philippines preferred.

Start Monday 2 November 2026.

Reports to Kathryn Friend, Founder.

Systems Xero, Pipedrive, Gmail, Google Drive and Sheets, FedEx, Toll, Team Global



Express, Logistics 360.



Reporting A short end-of-day update: what shipped, what is waiting, what needs Kathryn.



Key dates

• Applications close: Friday 16 October 2026.

• Paid test projects: week of 19 October.

• Offer made: by Friday 30 October.

• Trial starts: Monday 2 November.

title: Long-Form YouTube Vlog Editor (+ Short Clips)
description:
We're a small team working with a German lifestyle creator. She films long-form vlogs – trips, days out, behind the scenes – around 4–6 per month, for YouTube.
