title: Paid Media Specialist - Part Time
description:
About the Role



We are an e-commerce and digital consultancy acting as the fractional digital and e-commerce lead for a portfolio of premium fashion, swimwear, and lifestyle brands across the United States and Australia. We are looking for an exceptional Paid Media Specialist to own day-to-day execution across Meta and Google.



This person will live in the ad accounts every working day, keep tracking and product feeds healthy, build campaigns, and give honest, clear reads on what is and isn’t working. Strategy, budgets, and commercial targets are set at the leadership level; this role owns the execution underneath them, starting with a premium swimwear brand and potentially expanding to additional accounts as the business grows.



This is not a coordinator or assistant role. It is a hands-on performance marketing position for someone who wants ownership of real budgets across real brands.
, SMS, Klaviyo lifecycle work, and dashboard building are outside the scope of this role.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time to start, with potential to move to full-time as accounts are added

Location: Remote

Timezone: Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap required

Compensation: 10 USD

Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and own computer required



Key Responsibilities



Meta Advertising

Check every ad account daily for pacing, delivery, frequency, creative fatigue, and overnight issues

Build and restructure campaigns to a specified architecture while maintaining tight edit hygiene to avoid resetting the learning phase

Diagnose and fix accounts stuck in the learning phase with a genuine understanding of the underlying mechanics

Run a structured creative testing framework with disciplined naming conventions so results remain readable over time

Manage catalogue work, including dynamic product ads, Advantage+ catalogue ads, and collection ads

Google Advertising

Manage Performance Max, Standard Shopping, and brand and non-brand Search campaigns

Keep brand and non-brand performance reported separately so brand traffic is not mistaken for growth

Tracking & Product Feeds

Maintain Meta pixel, Conversions API, and server-side event health, including event match quality and deduplication

Troubleshoot tracking issues, especially when tracking breaks silently

Manage Google Merchant Center feed setup, diagnostics, disapprovals, and product data quality

Enforce UTM discipline across every campaign

Budget & Campaign Execution

Pace monthly budgets daily by brand, channel, and market, flagging potential overspend early

Advise on where and when budgets can be scaled

Traffic, name, and QA all creative assets provided by brand teams

Build every paid campaign to the trading and campaign calendar, on time

Paid Media Reporting

Deliver a weekly written update on Meta and Google performance by campaign, creative, and channel, with a focus on MER, CAC, and ROAS

Analyse creative performance and feed insights back to inform content strategy

Clearly explain gaps between platform-reported numbers, GA4, and Shopify data

Build and maintain a weekly reporting spreadsheet tracking all key metrics

Provide a short written daily handover at the end of each working day



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: Minimum 4 years of hands-on paid social and paid search experience for e-commerce brands, ideally in fashion, apparel, beauty, or another considered-purchase category. Agency experience is welcome, provided the candidate tailors strategy to each brand’s catalogue, price point, and audience rather than relying on templates

Strategy: Solid understanding of brand vs. performance marketing, blended attribution, and customer acquisition

Meta: Business Manager and Ads Manager administration across multiple ad accounts; knows when to use Advantage+ Shopping vs. manual campaigns; deep understanding of the learning phase, including conversion thresholds, consolidation, significant edits, frequency, and audience overlap; audience strategy across broad, interest, lookalike, and retargeting with correct exclusions

Google: Google Ads including Performance Max, Shopping, and Search; Google Merchant Center feeds and diagnostics; GA4 to a working standard, including events, conversions, channel groupings, and exploration reports

Tracking: Meta pixel and Conversions API setup and debugging, event match quality, and UTM discipline; able to spot broken tracking before anyone flags it

Analytics: Confident in Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, clean reporting) and comfortable discussing MER, CAC, blended ROAS, and incrementality

Communication: Excellent written English; weekly updates may be client-facing and must be clear, professional, and free of filler

Working Style: In the accounts every working day, raises problems before being asked, and is comfortable saying “I don’t know, let me find out”

Attention to Detail: Obsessive about craft; issues like a cropped logo, broken link, wrong price, or incorrect size guide are never treated as minor

Discretion: Absolute confidentiality is required, as this role has visibility into revenue, margin, and ad spend across competing brands

Reliability: Consistent hours, highly responsive, and proactive about flagging leave well in advance

title: UGC CREATIVE STRATEGIST (Scriptwriting and Creator Management)
description:
UGC CREATIVE STRATEGIST (Scriptwriting and Creator Management)

Full-Time | Remote | WRK Marketing

Starting Pay: $1,500/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week, Monday to Friday

Location: Remote



================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will be the UGC Creative Strategist for an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency. You'll guide our clients' UGC programs, manage their Trybe accounts, write the scripts behind our ads, and brief and manage content creators to deliver creative that actually sells. 



If you understand why one hook gets a 3% CTR and another dies in two seconds, and you can get a creator to deliver exactly what the ad needs without ten rounds of revisions, keep reading.



If you are looking for a pure copywriting role or a social media posting job, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients. We move fast. Priorities shift. Creative is the lever that moves results, and it has to keep up.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



Your job is to keep a steady flow of high-performing ad creative moving from idea to live ad, across multiple client accounts.



In a typical week, you might:



- Write UGC and direct-response video scripts: hooks, problem/solution angles, testimonials, product demos, and offer-driven ads

- Write multiple hook variations for every concept so media buyers have real options to test

- Research a client's product, customer reviews, competitors, and ad libraries to find angles worth testing

- Source, vet, and onboard content creators for new client accounts

- Write clear creator briefs covering the script, shot list, tone, do's and don'ts, and deadlines

- Manage creator relationships day to day: timelines, revisions, usage rights, and deliverables

- Review raw footage and give sharp, specific feedback that gets usable content on the first pass

- Work with editors to turn footage into finished ads and variations

- Sit down with media buyers to review creative performance, figure out what's winning and why, and feed those learnings into the next round of scripts

- Keep the creative pipeline organized in ClickUp so nothing stalls and nobody has to ask for status



The mix changes based on client needs and launch schedules. Flexibility is part of the job description.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



EXCELLENT COMMUNICATION

This is the most important requirement. You'll be writing scripts, briefing creators, giving feedback, and updating the team all day. You write clearly and concisely. You give feedback that is direct but keeps creators wanting to work with us. You can explain what's done, what's blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next in four sentences. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.



DIRECT-RESPONSE SCRIPTWRITING

You know the difference between content that looks nice and content that converts. You understand hooks, pacing, pain points, objection handling, social proof, and calls to action. You can write in a natural, spoken voice that sounds like a real person, not an ad.



CREATOR MANAGEMENT

You've worked with UGC creators or influencers before. You know how to find good ones, brief them well, manage timelines, and handle revisions without drama.



PERFORMANCE MINDSET

You're comfortable looking at hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS, and using what you see to d
 what to make next. You don't need to run ads, but you need to understand how creative drives the numbers.



GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with creators who go quiet. You chase the deliverable that's two days late. You don't wait to be told what's next.



STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Experience writing for ecommerce brands on Meta and TikTok. Basic video editing skills. Experience managing multiple client accounts at once.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), Meta Ads Manager and Ad Library, TikTok Ads and Creative Center, Motion or similar creative analytics tools, CapCut, Canva, Figma, UGC and creator platforms, Shopify, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, CapCut, and creator sourcing platforms is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,500/month



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============

Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

Your resume

1. Proof of work (required). We need to see both of the following:

-At least one direct-response ad scripts you wrote (Google Doc links are fine)

-At least one UGC or video ad you sourced, briefed, or managed (a live ad link, Drive link, or creator brief)

2. Performance results from creatives you worked on are a big plus. Design portfolios (static ads, graphics, branding) on their own will not be considered.

3. A personalized video introduction, 2 to 3 minutes. In your recording, please tell us:

-Why we should hire you

-Your experience writing ad scripts and managing content creators

-An ad you wrote or managed that performed well, and why you think it worked

-One script you wrote: walk us through the hook, the angle, and why you structured it that way

-How you work

-Why you are the right fit for this role

The recording does not need to be fancy. We just want to hear from you directly.  Applications missing any of the three required items will not be reviewed. We move quickly with strong candidates. If this sounds like you, apply now!

title: Customer Support Specialist (Remote, Philippines)
description:
Full-Time | Remote | USD $1,600 - $1,800 per month depending on experience



About Gymflow



Gymflow is a founder-led, bootstrapped SaaS platform built for modern gym and fitness studio owners. We

help automate everything from bookings and payments to member communication, access control and

branded member apps. We're on a mission to make fitness businesses run smoother and grow faster.

thrive.

• Handle key setups like branded app submissions and SMS

• Flag bugs and friction points so the product keeps improving



You'll join a small, focused team where your impact is immediate and visible.

 tickets via Featurebase, investigate issues in our admin

tools, payment records and logs, and solve them before escalating.

SMS via Twilio, and help with card terminals and door access.

problem and solve it, not just route tickets

HubSpot or Notion

Nice-to-Haves

Tools We Use



Featurebase · Linear · Slack · Notion · Loom · Stripe · Twilio · Google Meet · Claude



What Success Looks Like in Your First 6 Months



• You handle tickets independently, with a median first reply within 1 hour during your shift

• Your replies pass our weekly quality review: accurate, clear and solving the root cause

Location & Compensation

• USD $1,600 - $1,800 per month depending on experience, paid in USD or equivalent currency

• Long-term independent contractor



How to Apply



Apply here: 



When the form asks for our keyword, enter "Kettlebell." Applications without it won't be reviewed.

1 Your CV

Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a support test task, followed by two interviews. We respond

description:

Requirements

Video length: 12–15 minutes.



Channel type: Faceless YouTube channel.



YouTube experience: Proven experience editing YouTube videos is mandatory.



Copyright knowledge: Strong understanding of YouTube copyright rules, Content ID, copyright claims and strikes, footage licensing, and music usage.



Monetization policies: Understanding of YouTube's reused-content policies and monetization requirements.



Visual storytelling: Ability to find relevant footage of actual factories, industrial facilities, megaprojects, advanced technology, ships, railways, ports, energy infrastructure, and other large-scale developments.

Copyrighted footage or music used without proper authorization.

No understanding between the difference between copyright compliance and YouTube monetization eligibility.

Your experience editing faceless YouTube channels.

Thank you!

Tidyland Cleaning Services is looking for an experienced, highly proactive Sales & Operations Virtual Assistant to join our growing cleaning company.

We are specifically looking for someone who has previously worked with a residential cleaning company and has a proven track record of converting leads, following up consistently, meeting sales goals, and helping manage day-to-day operations.



Our ideal candidate doesn't wait to be told what to do. You notice problems, follow through, make decisions within your authority, and take ownership of results.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Sales & Lead Management



Respond quickly to new inbound leads from Meta, Google/LSA, and other sources

Call new leads immediately and confidently lead the sales conversation

Qualify prospects and recommend the appropriate cleaning service

Prepare and communicate residential cleaning quotes

Follow up aggressively but professionally with leads who don't book immediately

Reactivate old leads and previous customers

Convert one-time customers into recurring weekly, biweekly, and monthly clients

Track your close rate, booked revenue, follow-up activity, and other sales KPIs

Meet weekly and monthly sales goals

Identify why leads aren't converting and proactively recommend improvements

Handle customer calls, texts,
s, rescheduling, service questions, and concerns

Assist with scheduling and booking management

Monitor upcoming jobs and proactively catch scheduling or staffing problems

Help resolve customer and cleaner issues without immediately escalating every situation to the owner

Maintain accurate customer, booking, and CRM records

Communicate professionally with both customers and contractors

Follow company SOPs while using good judgment when situations fall outside an SOP



Weekend Coverage

This position will include weekend coverage (one weekend day).  You must be comfortable handling incoming leads, customers, cleaner communication, scheduling issues, and urgent operational matters during your assigned weekend hours.



Systems We Use



Experience with cleaning-company software is required. Our current systems include BookingKoala, GoHighLevel (GHL), Slack, Quo/OpenPhone, Google Sheets, and related tools.



Experience with BookingKoala and/or GoHighLevel is a major advantage.



Who We're Looking For

Have actual sales experience, not just customer-service experience

Can provide examples of sales goals/KPIs you were responsible for and results you achieved

Know how to move a prospect toward a decision instead of simply answering questions

Rarely make the same mistake twice

Document important information without being reminded

Follow through until a task is actually completed

Can prioritize when several things happen at once

Are comfortable being held accountable to measurable performance goals

Can work independently without constant supervision

Are proactive and bring solutions—not just problems—to management

Want to grow into a position with significant responsibility



This Position Is NOT For You If:

You've never worked with a cleaning company

You dislike making sales calls

You wait for customers to tell you what they want instead of guiding the sale

You are uncomfortable following up with leads multiple times

You need constant reminders to complete tasks

You frequently miss details

You wait for the owner to solve routine problems

You're looking for a low-pressure customer service/chat position



What Success Looks Like



We are building a company that can operate without the owner being involved in everyday sales and operations.



The person we hire will have an opportunity to become a key member of the company and take on increasing responsibility.



You will be expected to help us:



Increase lead-to-booking conversion • Increase recurring customers • Improve follow-up • Reduce missed opportunities • Keep operations organized • Improve customer experience • Help the business run without constant owner involvement



There is significant growth potential for someone who demonstrates leadership, reliability, excellent judgment, and strong results.



How to Apply — Please Read Carefully



Do NOT send us a generic application.

title: Shopify Catalog Manager for HammerHead
description:
About HammerHead®

HammerHead® is a DTC brand making solid metal plumbing fixtures: shower heads, shower systems, filtration, and next up, bathroom faucets. We sell on Amazon and Shopify, primarily in the US with growing Canada presence. We're on pace for $25M in 2026 with a path to $100M by end of 2029.

We build for the long term. Real products, real margins, small team where every hire matters.





The Role

The Shopify Catalog Manager owns the health, accuracy, and performance of our Shopify catalog in the US and Canada. You'll run the day-to-day of the storefront catalog and be the person who makes sure our product pages are clean, our variants and bundles are built right, our pricing is correct, and our data matches every system it touches.

This role is critical. You are the operator who keeps our storefront accurate, and everything connected to it, running.





What You'll Own



Product Setup & Launches

• Build new Shopify listings end to end: title, description, metafields, SEO title and meta description, URL handle, images, spec sheet and installation manual links, and variant options

• Set pricing correctly, including cost per item, price, and compare-at price per our pricing rules

• Apply the right theme template, product category, product type, collections, and flow-rate tags to every product

• Verify compliance behavior before go-live, including the California pop-up and shipping restrictions by flow rate (2.5 GPM vs. 1.75 GPM)

• Work alongside the Head of Marketing, Product Development, and Supply Chain on launch timing, pricing, and creative



Catalog Operations

• Create and maintain virtual bundles, including SKU naming, bundle pricing, bundle tagging, and mapping to component SKUs in ByteStand

• Maintain collections, product templates, and shipping profiles (US, non-California US, California-compliant, Canada)

• Keep US and Canada listings separate and correct, including fulfillment settings

• Run bulk catalog updates and imports without breaking live pages

• Catalog audits and cleanup: duplicates, missing content, wrong templates, wrong tags, and stale products



Systems & Data Integrity

• Keep Shopify aligned with Amazon SKUs and UPCs, and map Shopify variant and inventory IDs to our Airtable product records

• Configure inventory and price sync settings in ByteStand and troubleshoot inventory sync issues

• Set up Loop subscription selling plans and swap flows for filter products so customers never subscribe to or receive the wrong item

• Monitor the Shopify to Meta catalog sync weekly and clear catalog errors for
 and Instagram

• Run recurring maintenance checks on installed Shopify apps and refresh broken connections



Performance & Reporting

• Track product page and collection performance, and flag conversion, discoverability, and merchandising opportunities

• Improve onsite search, collection sorting, filters, and cross-sells

• Compile weekly Shopify metrics into the reporting sheet



Team

• Coordinate daily with the Head of Marketing on channel priorities

• Document every process change and update the ClickUp SOPs when a workflow changes

• Complete daily tasks in ClickUp

• Communicate via Slack per team standards

• Participate in the Weekly L10 Team Meeting



Who You Are

• 3+ years of hands-on Shopify experience managing the catalog of a real DTC or ecommerce brand (not just VA-level data entry)

• Advanced in Shopify products, variants, collections, tags, metafields, theme templates, and SEO fields

• Comfortable with bulk edits and CSV imports at scale, regardless of the software wrapper (native Shopify, Matrixify, or similar)

• Working knowledge of how Shopify connects to inventory and pricing sync apps, subscription apps like Loop, Klaviyo, Meta and Google feeds, and Airtable (Amazon Seller Central experience is a plus)

• You can look at a product page and know within minutes whether it's built right

• You take ownership of the channel and flag issues before we ask



Details

• Compensation: up to $2,000 USD/month. Room to grow with performance.

• Bonus: 5–15% of annual salary based on performance.

• Type: Full-time independent contractor

• Location: Remote

• Working hours: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday, with a minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with our core business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST)

• Reports to: Head of Marketing

• Start date: ASAP — this role is time-critical

• PTO: 10 working days of paid annual leave per year, accrued prorated in the first year



How to Apply

Apply directly through the job post and attach your resume. Please include a short Loom (3–5 minutes) walking us through:

• A brand whose Shopify catalog you've managed and what you owned

• A catalog problem you solved end to end (a variant, bundle, sync, or data issue)

• Why this role interests you



We move fast on strong candidates.

title: YouTube & Short-Form Video Editor with Creative Storytelling Skills
description:
Remote | Part-time | Ongoing work



Hi! I’m Eva, a London-based creator, entrepreneur and mum of three. My content explores cultural experiences, interesting activities and events, family adventures, and my journey building small businesses.



I’m looking for a talented video editor who can turn my footage and ideas into engaging YouTube videos, Shorts and Instagram Reels.



Creative thinking is essential. You should enjoy finding the strongest hook, shaping a story and suggesting ways to make a video more compelling.





What you’ll do



- Edit YouTube videos from footage of experiences, activities and events, as well as talking-to-camera videos.



- Develop strong openings and a clear story flow that keeps viewers interested.



- Add relevant B-roll, captions, text, music, sound effects and visual effects where they improve the video.



- Improve audio, colour and pacing for a polished, natural result.



- Identify strong moments from YouTube videos and turn them into standalone Shorts and Reels, with their own hooks and satisfying endings.



- Edit separately filmed vertical videos to make them more engaging.



- Suggest hook options, story angles and, over time, short scripts or talking points.



- Flag missing footage or narration and suggest what I should record to complete the story.



I like engaging edits with personality, humour and thoughtful pacing. Effects should support the story and suit the moment.





Who I’m looking for



- A portfolio showing both YouTube videos and short-form content.



- Strong storytelling skills: you can recognise what is interesting in raw footage and build a video around it.



- Good written and spoken English, including the ability to write natural hooks and accurate captions.



- Confidence suggesting ideas and explaining your creative choices.



- Reliability, clear communication and an organised approach to files and deadlines.



- Openness to feedback and the ability to apply what you learn to future videos.



- Experience using an video editing tool.



-Experience in creating covers for youtube videos



- Experience editing personal creator content, cultural or travel videos, vlogs, or talking videos would be especially relevant.





How we’ll work together



-Initially, we’ll work closely so you can learn my voice, audience and preferences. I’ll share footage, reference videos and a short written or voice-note brief.



-As we build a working relationship, I’d like you to take increasing ownership of hooks, structure and creative suggestions, with less detailed direction from me and be more proactive.





Workload and payment



- We will start with a trial period with the agreed payment and total hours of work.  

- After trial period we will establish a regular, long-term part-time role.

- Please share your availability and rate.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid trial using footage I provide. This will involve suggesting two hook options and editing a 60–90-second video so we can assess storytelling, editing style and communication.



We’ll agree on the fee and scope before you begin.



How to apply



Please send to 
 



A brief introduction and why this role interests you.



Two or three relevant portfolio examples, including at least one YouTube video and one Short/Reel. Explain your contribution to each.



Your editing software, availability and usual turnaround time.



Your rates as outlined above.



A short answer to this question: “If I send you footage from an interesting cultural event without a script, how would you find the hook and shape the story?”



I’m looking for someone who enjoys contributing ideas and would like to grow with a creator over time.



Looking forward to seeing your work!



Eva

title: German-Speaking Video Editor (Full Time) - Short Form Ads, VSLs & Static Ads
description:
We run a German e-commerce brand. Our ads are what sell the product, so creative is the core of the business - not a side task.



I am looking for ONE person, full time, long term, who owns our creative output: short form ads, VSLs and static image ads.



TWO THINGS MATTER MOST. Everything else I can teach.



1. YOUR GERMAN

You must read and write German at a level where you can spot a bad sentence.

Not Google Translate. Not "I studied a little". If a German caption or headline sounds off, you have to feel it. One wrong word on a static kills the whole ad.



IF YOU DO NOT SPEAK GERMAN - READ THIS

I know how few people in the Philippines speak German. So here is your door, and it is a real one:

If you believe you would do this job better than a German speaker, tell me why. Not "I am a fast learner" - give me something I can judge. Maybe you have already produced German or other foreign language ads for a client and you have the numbers. Maybe you have a system for working in a language you do not speak and it has held up. Maybe your editing is simply on another level and you are already learning German.

Write me a few honest sentences about it. I read every single one.

But know what you are up against: the German speaker does not have to convince me of anything.



2. YOU THINK FOR YOURSELF

I do not want someone who sits and waits for a brief.

I want someone who watches what our competitors are running, has an idea on Tuesday morning, builds it, and shows it to me on Wednesday. Someone who says "I want to try this angle" and then tries it. Someone who notices that a certain topic keeps getting comments and makes three more videos about it without being asked.

If you need a storyboard for every single video, this is the wrong job. If you want to test your own ideas with a real ad budget behind them, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Short form ads (15-60s)

- Edit from B-roll, stock, UGC and AI footage

- Hooks, captions, pacing, sound - the full cut



VSLs (1-3 min)

- Build long form sales videos from a script and a voiceover

- Keep 15-20 shots moving so nobody scrolls away



Adapting English videos into German

- Swap the voiceover, rebuild every caption, re-time every cut to the new audio

- The result has to look like it was made in German, not translated into it



Static image ads

- Design 1:1 and 4:5 ads from product photos, lifestyle shots and before/after images

- Set German headlines that are readable on a phone at scroll speed

- Build variations of a winner: same layout, new headline, new image

- Clean up supplier images - remove foreign text, fix labels



Your own stuff

- Bring me ideas. New angles, new hooks, new topics, formats you have seen working somewhere else.

- A part of your week is yours to test what you believe in.



OUTPUT PER WEEK

4-6 finished videos and 8-10 statics, ready to upload. At least one of them your own idea.



WHAT I GIVE YOU

- Scripts, raw footage, product photos, brand assets, voiceover tool access

- Clear briefs when it matters and freedom when it does not

- Fast feedback, usually the same day

- Stable full time work, paid monthly, no project hopping

- Real ad spend behind your ideas, and the numbers back so you see what worked



TOOLS

CapCut or Premiere for video, Photoshop, Canva or Figma for statics. Your choice, as long as the output is clean.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Send 2-3 videos you edited yourself and 2-3 static ads you designed yourself. One line each on what YOU did.

2. One paragraph about your German: how good it is, where you learned it, and what you have already produced in German.

   If you do not speak German, write the honest paragraph I asked for above instead.

3. Tell me about one video or ad that YOU came up with yourself - not on anyone's brief. What was the idea, and how did it go?

4. Put the word SCHNITT in your subject line so I know you read this.



Applications without points 2 and 3 I do not read.

You'll edit video ads for both brands, full time.



- Each week you get clear written briefs with the script, the hooks, reference ads and

  notes on exactly what to make.

- You turn each brief into finished ads, usually in several versions (different hooks,

  different lengths) so we can test what works.

- You work next to our current editor, so you're never figuring things out alone.

- You see the results. We run every ad and track which ones win, and part of your pay

  is tied to that.



Some of our ads are in German. You don't need to speak it: every German ad comes with

an English version of each line.



WHAT YOU GET

- Paid training: $7/hour for your first 14 days (about $1,200/month full time).

- After training: $8/hour (about $1,390/month).

- Performance bonus on top, based on the ads you produce. We share the details during

  the interview.

- Full access to eCom Talent, the most elite video ad editing course in ecommerce,

  paid for by us. You'll learn hooks, retention, pacing, statics and AI tools: the

  reasons ads work, which most editors are never taught.

- Room to grow. We run two brands, both growing, and we promote from within. Editors

  who understand why ads win move into bigger roles.

- A long-term home: full time, remote and stable.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hunger matters more to us than your current level. If you're already great, amazing.

If you're good and determined to become great, we built this role for you.



You're a fit if:

- This will be your ONLY job. Full time, no school, no side clients. We mean this.

- You want to stay somewhere for years, not months.

- You're strong in CapCut and have a portfolio of short vertical videos (ads, TikToks,

  Reels, UGC).

- You know what a hook is and why the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

- You take feedback well and fix things fast.

- You have a reliable computer and stable internet.



Bonus points:

- You've edited paid ads for ecommerce brands.

- You've used HeyGen, Google Flow or other AI video tools.



HOW WE WORK

- Flexible hours, with a few hours of overlap each day with our team in Europe.

- A team meeting every two weeks. Attendance is mandatory.

- Briefs come in through Trello, you deliver in Google Drive, and we talk on Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Fill out this form: 

2. In the form, include a Loom video (5 minutes max). Introduce yourself, show 2 or 3

   videos you're proud of, and walk us through how you made one of them.

3. Type the words HOOK FIRST as your first answer in the form. This shows us you read

   the whole post.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

1. We watch every Loom that comes in through the form.

2. Shortlisted editors get a call with us. Ask us anything, this goes both ways.

3. Final candidates get a test brief: a real ad brief, about 3 to 4 hours of work. The

   test is unpaid. If you're the editor we're looking for, you'll enjoy it.

4. We hire one editor, who starts with the 14-day paid training.

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO
description:
Chief of Staff to the CEO (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA is a group of healthcare companies in Atlanta, Georgia: home care, skilled nursing, and healthcare staffing. We are a small team and we are growing quickly. I am the founder and majority owner. I am hiring a chief of staff to be my right-hand person. I have founded and built several successful companies, and you will work with me on building this one and the others that follow. There will be opportunities for promotion for the right person.



THE JOB

A company cannot see its own problems. Somebody has to look at the work, compare it to the standard, and say plainly what they found. As my chief of staff, you do that for me across every part of the business.



You will:

- Track every commitment my managers make to me and follow each one until it is done or I drop it.

- Read the weekly financial and operating reports before I do and tell me what is wrong with them.

- Tell a manager, in writing, when a report or plan does not meet the standard, and why.

- Tell me when I am wrong, in writing, with the facts, before I d
.

- Prepare my meetings and close them out with who owns each item and the date it is due.

- Draft memos, policies, and correspondence for my review.



WHO SUCCEEDS IN THIS JOB

You are an exceptional communicator. You are diligent about your work. And you are a bulldog: once you are given something, you do not let go of it until it is finished and finished right.

You love coaching and growing people, and you know what that takes. Coaching means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh. Growing people takes constant attention to that coaching.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

Most of this job is conversations other people would rather not have. If you prefer to wait for a better moment, soften a finding until it stops saying anything, reply "noted" when you disagree, or report a missed deadline after it is missed, this job will be miserable for you.



I am also not looking for someone who enjoys arguing. The disagreements here are about whether work meets a standard and what something costs the company. Nothing else is worth my time or yours.



HOW WE WORK

I make the final decision. Your job is to make sure every material fact is in front of me when I make it, especially the ones nobody wanted to bring me. Once I d
, you carry it out. If new facts appear, you bring them back.

If you are behind, you tell me before the deadline.

If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

Most of your working day falls in US Eastern business hours. Some weeks run well past forty hours.



WHAT YOU NEED

- An MBA, a JD, or a comparable graduate degree.

- Excellent written English. Most of this job happens in writing.

- An operational understanding of sales and accounting, the two essential disciplines in business. You can read a profit and loss statement and a payroll report and find the line that does not belong.

- Experience reporting problems to people senior to you and getting them fixed: operations, audit, consulting, finance, legal, or project management.

- US healthcare, payroll, or billing experience helps but is not required.



PAY

USD 2,500 per month. Full-time and long-term.



HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter. Answer these three questions in writing, in under 600 words total. Applications that skip a question will not be read.

1. Describe a time you told someone senior to you that their work or decision was wrong. What did you say, what did they do, and what happened next? If they overruled you, what did you do after that?

2. A manager tells you a project is on track. The numbers you have show it will miss its date by three weeks. The manager has been with the company eight years and is well liked. You report to the CEO. Write the exact message you would send, and say who receives it.

3. Which part of this job post is weakest, and why?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid work sample and a live interview.

title: Quality Assurance/Registered Nurse
description:
Position Summary

OPA Home Care operates a strict, gated Referral-to-Cash Operating System (v2.2) designed to deliver consistent outcomes regardless of who executes the process. Every stage has one owner, binary “done” definitions recorded in AxisCare, mandatory QA audits, and clear KPIs. OPA has maintained a perfect shift coverage record – zero missed shifts since May 23, 2024. As our Quality Assurance & Operations Administrator, you will execute daily audits, enforce gate compliance, and produce reporting that keeps the pipeline running with discipline and integrity. You will own the audit function across all active pipeline stages and escalate violations without delay.



Important: This role involves reviewing client records that may contain Protected Health Information (PHI). HIPAA training is required and must be completed before AxisCare access is granted. No exceptions.



Key Responsibilities

Core QA & Audit Ownership



• Perform the full Stage 1 QA Audit within 24 hours of every Referral ? Intake completion – verifying lead entry timestamps, contact cadence, SLA execution while client is on the phone, deposit calculation and posting, gate integrity, referral source entry in both required AxisCare locations, and Director of Operations start authorization.

• Expand QA audits to additional stages (Intake ? Care Plan, Staffing, Visit Completion, Billing, and Recruiting pipeline) as those stages are finalized and directed.

• Track stage completion misses by employee and stage. Support corrective action by reporting misses to the task owner and Director of Operations within 24 hours of identification.

• Own the Exception Tracking Protocol: confirm every gate bypass is logged with all four required fields (exception type, reason, approved-by, normalization deadline) and normalized by the applicable deadline – 24 hours for emergency starts, 48 hours for gate overrides. Escalate missed normalizations immediately.

• Run weekly cross-pipeline reviews and support root-cause analysis when lag KPIs fail.

• Deliver daily audit summaries and weekly pipeline reports to the Director of Operations, CEO, and designated team members. Flag gate violations immediately – no batching of critical issues.



Operations Support

• Monitor AxisCare continuously for gate integrity, status accuracy, medically fragile designations, documentation compliance, and system rule adherence.

• Enforce core system rules without exception: one owner per stage, no downstream action before gate confirmation, “if it is not logged in AxisCare, it did not happen,” and no informal modifications.

• Support scheduling, intake, clinical, and billing teams with repeatable administrative and auditing tasks as directed by the Director of Operations.



Compliance & Reporting

• Maintain strict HIPAA compliance in all work involving client data, at all times.

• Produce clear, accurate, and timely audit reports and documentation.

• Participate in process improvement as the company scales and additional OS stages are activated.



Success Metrics

• 100% of assigned QA audits completed within required timeframes.

• 100% of exceptions normalized by deadline or escalated with documented reason before deadline.

• Zero unaddressed critical issues in audit reports – all gate violations flagged same day.

• Reporting delivered on schedule with no gaps.

• Contribution to overall pipeline KPIs: conversion rates, shift coverage, collection rates.



Qualifications

• Must be an RN(required) 

2+ years of experience in quality assurance, process auditing, operations coordination, or healthcare administration. Home care, BPO, or healthcare support experience is a strong advantage.

• Demonstrated attention to detail and documented ability to enforce strict processes and rules – including escalating when colleagues are non-compliant.

• Strong proficiency with EMR/EHR or care management systems. AxisCare experience is highly preferred; fast independent learners will be considered.

• Excellent written and spoken English – clear, professional, and precise in all communications.

• Reliable high-speed internet, power backup, and a quiet dedicated workspace for US night-shift hours.

• Experience with HIPAA or equivalent data privacy standards. Candidates without prior HIPAA experience must complete comprehensive training before system access is granted.

• Comfortable working independently with a high degree of self-direction while coordinating with a US-based team via Slack,
, and scheduled calls.



Preferred

• Background in home care, senior care, or healthcare BPO operations.

• Experience creating structured audit summaries and operational reports.

• Familiarity with US healthcare compliance environments or payer operations (VA, Medicaid, private pay).



Compensation & Benefits

• Monthly salary: $1,200 USD. Performance bonus bridges toward higher earnings for strong and consistent performers.

• Paid training on OPA’s Operating System, AxisCare, and HIPAA – completed before system access is granted.

• Opportunity to grow into expanded audit and operations scope as the company scales.



Why Join OPA?

You will play a foundational role in protecting a rigorous, systems-driven operation that delivers exceptional reliability to clients and families. OPA has maintained zero missed shifts since May 23, 2024 – a record this role directly protects. If you are process-oriented, thrive on detail and consistency, and want to contribute to a growing US home care company while working remotely from the Philippines, this role is built for you.

title: Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)
description:
Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)



Company: Eveready Express

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time)

Location: Remote



About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.



The ideal candidate must have at least two (2) years of experience working in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry and possess strong dispatching, route planning, and load coordination skills. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to effectively multitask, possess intermediate English communication skills, demonstrate expert computer skills, and have a growth mindset with a willingness to continuously learn and improve.



As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched

26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb. weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans

Cargo Vans

Ram ProMaster (High Roof)

About Eveready Express



Founded in 1984, Eveready Express is a trusted leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution services. We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Dispatch vehicles based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.

Negotiate rates with drivers while maintaining a target minimum 40% gross margin.

Assign loads efficiently to maximize profitability and operational performance.

Coordinate pickups and deliveries to ensure customer service expectations are met.

Driver Communication

Maintain continuous communication with drivers throughout their routes.

Provide dispatch instructions, updates, route changes, and operational support.

Ensure drivers follow company procedures and customer requirements.

Routing & Scheduling

Plan efficient delivery routes to minimize transit time, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

Adjust schedules quickly as operational needs or unforeseen circumstances arise.

Balance driver availability with customer delivery requirements.

Shipment Tracking

Monitor shipments in real time using GPS and dispatch software.

Proactively identify delays and coordinate solutions to minimize service disruptions.

Provide timely shipment updates to customers and internal teams.

Customer Service

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch.

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain accurate dispatch records, driver logs, shipment notes, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and Proofs of Delivery (PODs).

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Problem Solving

Resolve logistical challenges including traffic delays, vehicle breakdowns, weather disruptions, missed appointments, and last-minute schedule changes.

Safety & Regulatory Compliance

Verify driver qualifications, vehicle readiness, insurance, and compliance with company safety standards.

Work closely with HR and Operations to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.

Team Collaboration

Collaborate with Customer Service, Operations, Billing, Sales, HR, Warehouse, and Drivers to ensure seamless daily operations.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve dispatch efficiency, operational workflows, and customer satisfaction.

Recommend process improvements and innovative solutions to management.

Qualifications

Required: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry.

Previous experience dispatching 26-foot box trucks, cargo vans, sprinter vans, or final-mile delivery vehicles is required.

Strong understanding of DOT regulations, ELD compliance, and Hours of Service (HOS) requirements.

Experience negotiating driver rates while maintaining profitability and service quality.

Expert computer skills, including the ability to quickly navigate multiple applications, browser tabs, spreadsheets, dispatch platforms, and communication tools simultaneously.

Proficiency with Transportation Management Systems (TMS), dispatch software, GPS tracking platforms, load boards, CRM systems, Microsoft Office (especially Excel), Google Workspace, and web-based applications.

Strong ability to multitask and manage multiple drivers, customers, deliveries, and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal).

Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable communicating professionally with drivers, customers, brokers, and internal teams.

Strong critical-thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

Dependable, self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

Demonstrates a growth mindset, is coachable, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

Must be available to work a full-time schedule, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as operational needs require.

Hardware & Technical Requirements



Applicants must have the following:



Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 or equivalent preferred)

RAM: Minimum 16 GB

Storage: At least 100 GB of available disk space

Second monitor for efficient multitasking

Backup computer

Noise-canceling headset

Internet: Minimum 20 Mbps wired connection for both your primary and backup internet service providers

USB sticks, mobile hotspots, wireless dongles, or satellite internet connections are not permitted as backup internet connections.

Opportunities for advancement within the company

to

Only applicants who demonstrate attention to detail, follow instructions, and show genuine interest in joining our team will move forward in the hiring process.

 or Google Meet video interview.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion and strive to foster a professional, respectful, and collaborative environment where all independent contractors have an equal opportunity to succeed based on their qualifications, performance, and commitment.

title: Marketing and Customer Growth Lead
description:
Marketing and Customer Growth Lead

CoinPort Exchange, 

Remote, Philippines based. Full time.



Grow a regulated Australian crypto exchange from the ground up. You own the creative and the results. Our compliance team signs off before anything goes live, because that is what being regulated means.



- 100% work from home, no commute ever

- 36 hours a week, not the usual 48

- Every second Friday off, so a long weekend every fortnight



ABOUT COINPORT



CoinPort is an AUSTRAC registered Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) based in Melbourne, Australia. We run a regulated AUD crypto exchange, built to do things properly in a space that often doesn't.



We are a lean team that takes compliance seriously. We need someone to take marketing off the founders' plates and turn it into a real growth engine, starting in Australia. A move into the Philippines may follow later, subject to local licensing.



Everyone here runs their own station. There is no hand holding and no bureaucracy. If a blank canvas excites you rather than worries you, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



The role is roughly 80% marketing and 20% customer contact. You report to our Operations Manager and work closely with our CEO on marketing direction.



Marketing (about 80%)

- Marketing strategy for the Australian market, with you setting the direction

- Paid ads on Google, Meta and crypto relevant platforms, managing your own monthly budget

- Social media end to end: content calendar, copy, design briefs, scheduling and community replies

- On camera video: explainers, promos and social reels

- Brand consistency across every CoinPort touchpoint

- Tracking results, cutting what doesn't work and reporting weekly

- Preparing every ad and post for compliance review before it goes live



Customer contact (about 20%)

- Chat and phone support for Australian customers

- Welcoming new users and walking them through onboarding and identity checks

- Following up with people who get stuck partway through signup



Talking to customers every day is the best market research you will get.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS



- A marketing plan for Australia, agreed with the CEO

- Google and Meta ad accounts approved for crypto advertising and running live campaigns

- A steady weekly posting rhythm across our main social channels

- At least four short videos published, with you on camera

- A weekly report covering signups, verified users and first deposits

- Faster onboarding, with fewer new users stalling before their first deposit



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on camera and on the phone with Australian customers.

- Confident on camera, and able to explain crypto clearly to a first time buyer

- Comfortable speaking with customers by phone

- Able to run ads and social campaigns without an agency

- A genuine interest in crypto, fintech or financial services. You don't need to be a trader, but you need to care about the space.

- Self directed, with a track record of owning something and growing it

- Happy working in a small team where everyone has a wide remit

- Bonus: experience marketing to Filipino audiences



COMPENSATION AND HOURS



Base pay: AUD $2,000 per month

Bonus: Performance linked, tied to the goals above

13th month pay: Included, paid every December

Equipment: Allowance provided

Hours: 36 a week, averaged over a fortnight

Schedule: 8 hours a day, Monday to Thursday every week, plus Friday every second week

Time zone: Hours overlap with Melbourne business hours, around 6am to 2pm Manila time during Australian daylight saving and 7am to 3pm otherwise

Location: 100% work from home in the Philippines

Engagement: Contractor to start, moving to a staff role after a successful trial period, with length to be agreed



Pay grows when results do. No six day weeks and no commute, ever.



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application. Send these four things to 
 with the subject line "Marketing and Customer Growth Lead: [your name]".



1. A 60 to 90 second intro video in English. Tell us who you are, why crypto marketing interests you, and show us your camera presence. A simple selfie video is fine. If you speak Tagalog, a second version in Tagalog is a welcome bonus.

2. Your best marketing work. Links to campaigns, social accounts you've managed, content you've made, or results you're proud of. Any industry counts. If you've grown your own following, share that too.

3. A time marketing made a real difference. What was the situation, what did you do, and what happened as a result?

4. Your CV. What you've built and shipped matters more to us than a degree from years ago.



Applications without the video or the written answer won't progress. That's not us being strict. This role is communication first.



What happens next: shortlisted applicants are invited to a video call, followed by a short paid task and a final interview with the founders.

title: Experienced QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper
description:
Remote in the Philippines • Part-time • Two positions available



CAD $8/hour (not USD) | Approximately 15–20 hours/week

Start as soon as possible following selection



Hello, my name is Alice Wynter, founder of a Canadian bookkeeping practice supporting small businesses. I’m looking for two experienced bookkeepers to join our small team and take ownership of client files.  Clear communication, initiative, and reliability matter most to me.   You must be experienced for this role, please do not apply if you do not fit all the requirements listed below.



The role



You’ll maintain books in QuickBooks Online, reconcile bank and credit-card accounts, investigate discrepancies, prepare questions about missing information, and keep client task sheets updated. You’ll also prepare supporting records for GST/HST filings and year-end accountant handoffs. I handle client calls and
s, you will never have client contact.  



What you bring



At least three years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience and three years of practical bookkeeping experience. These can be the same years.  THESE SKILLS ARE A MUST.   Again, please do not apply if you do not have at least these two skills under your belt. 



Experience managing multiple client files independently, including Canadian bookkeeping, GST/HST, accruals, and financial reports.   Over time, you will be managing possibly up to 25 to 30 clients per month.    



Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and CSV files. Confidence using Word, Google Docs, and Google Drive to prepare documents and organize shared files.



Clear English, attention to detail, and the initiative to investigate problems, ask questions, and apply feedback.



A reliable computer, stable internet, and consistent availability. Relevant bookkeeping courses and certifications are valued.



Commitment and support



I ask that you reserve regular weekly hours, meet deadlines, and provide updates. Questions are welcome, but flag problems early. You must be available for at least two paid hours of one-on-one virtual meetings with me each week to review client files. Meeting times are agreed in advance and included in your weekly hours.   This is a serious role, meaning if you are looking to add these hours to another role/position/side gig I would highly suggest that you DO NOT apply.   



Your first month



We’ll begin with a one-month paid trial at CAD $8/hour. Clients and hours will build gradually as we show you our processes and client requirements. By month-end, we expect you to manage assigned routine work independently, with support for complex questions. We’ll provide feedback and d
 at month-end whether to continue.



This is an independent contractor role, paid weekly in CAD through Wise against invoices. Client confidentiality is essential.



How to apply



Use the subject “Senior QBO Bookkeeper – [Your Name]”. Send your résumé and a short note covering:



Your QBO and Canadian bookkeeping experience, number of clients managed, relevant courses or certifications, and spreadsheet skills.



One brief example of a reconciliation problem you personally solved, without confidential client details.



Your weekly availability in Philippine time, other work commitments, earliest start date, and confirmation of the rate, paid trial, and weekly meetings.



Please address each point. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview via Google Meet.  



Thank you!



Alice Wynter

title: AI VIDEO ADS EDITOR | META, INSTAGRAM, TIKTOK
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who clearly understands one thing:

A good ad does more than look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and pushes people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We're looking for someone to help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels, working full-time (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits built from reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Senior Operations Manager, Home Care (Remote, Philippines-based)



OPA Home Care is a licensed home care agency in Atlanta, Georgia, and part of a small group of healthcare companies I founded and own. Our caregivers serve clients in their homes every day. Our scheduling and coordination team works remotely from the Philippines. I am hiring a senior operations manager to watch that team throughout the US day and make sure every piece of work meets the OPA standard.



THE JOB

A client waiting for a caregiver cannot see our schedule, and the company cannot watch its own team. Somebody has to look at the work while it is happening, find what is missing, and get it fixed before it reaches a client. That is this job.



You will:

- Watch open shifts, call-outs, and unconfirmed visits from the start of the US day to the end, and make sure each one has an owner and gets closed.

- Check the schedulers' and coordinators' work against the standard every day, and tell them in writing where it falls short.

- Review recorded calls and
s. Every call and
 at OPA is recorded and transcribed.

- Follow up on every open item, every time, until it is closed. Sending a message does not close an item.

- Close each day with a written report: what is still open, who owns it, and when it will be done.

- Tell me before a deadline when something is going to be late.



THE OPA STANDARD

We hire and coach on five standards. You must meet all five, and you must hold the team to them.

1. Attention to detail. You catch the shift with no caregiver, the wrong date, and the note that says "covered" when the visit is not covered.

2. Self-starter. You find the problem before anyone assigns it to you.

3. Follow-up. Every item, every time, without fail. If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

4. Coachability. When you are corrected, your next piece of work shows the correction.

5. Lagniappe. A little bit extra: one more call, one more check, done because the client needed it.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

If "I already messaged them" sounds like a finished task to you, you will fail here. If you would rather not correct a coordinator who has been here longer than you, or you report Monday's problem on Friday, this job will be miserable for you.

Coaching here means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least two years in operations, scheduling, or coordination for a US home care agency. Experience supervising a scheduling or coordination team is strongly preferred.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience with a home care scheduling system. We use AxisCare. WellSky (ClearCare) or AlayaCare experience also counts.

- Availability for the full US Eastern business day. Some days run longer.

- A reliable computer and internet connection, with a backup for each.



PAY

USD 1,500 per month, paid in two equal payments of USD 750 on the 15th and on the last day of each month. Full-time and long-term. This is the offer. There is no range.



HOW TO APPLY

Read every instruction. Following them is part of the test.

- Use this subject line: Senior Ops Manager, your full name, and the word Lagniappe.

- Include a link to your resume that opens without requesting access. We will check it.

- No cover letter. Answer the four questions below, numbered, in under 700 words total.

- Applications that skip a question or use a different subject line will not be read.

- We may reply with one follow-up question. Answer it within 24 hours.

Below is an end-of-day note a scheduler sent to her manager. OPA rule: a caregiver whose credentialing is not complete may not work after her 30th day.



"Tuesday wrap-up. All 38 shifts for Wednesday are confirmed. Two call-outs today, both handled. Maria R. called out of the Johnson visit (8 a.m. to 2 p.m.) and Ana T. covered it. Wednesday is her 31st day, and her credentialing paperwork is almost done. Mrs. Williams' daughter called about a visit she says nobody showed up for on Monday. I told her we would look into it."



List every problem in this note. Then write the exact message you would send the scheduler, and say what you would do yourself before the US day ends.



QUESTION 2

Describe a time someone senior to you corrected your work. What exactly was wrong, what did you change, and how did your next piece of work show the change?



QUESTION 3

Describe an item you had to follow up on three or more times before it was closed. Who owned it, what kept it open, and how did it finally close? Give the dates.



QUESTION 4

Tell us about something you did in your last job that nobody asked you to do. What did it take, and what did it change for the company or the client?
